title: Castles
content: I dream about boats alot. Last night I was in an Asian country visiting. It was the first time and not my usual dream city, flat, like nothing was familiar, it seemed to gave been china but I'm unsure. I was by a beach and a coast and I was being urged by people to look over at something, and I looked and across the water were 2 castles/large buildings and I cannot stop thinking about them. This was so vivid as so much else was going on in my dream, conflicts with family, travelling streets, and all NEW! But this was still. Everyone was looking transfixed. What are these places I've never seen before? Even the look of them was unusual, they were both matt colour, all one colour/shade, one was pinkish and one was beige. As I say, I'm so used to my usual places and this is sticking out. Anyone have anything similar?
